title: AI models and costs
summary: The user's own OpenRouter key, their choice of model, and what it costs.

stories.as: someone paying for my own AI usage
stories.want: to see what each feature costs me
stories.soThat: I can choose a cheaper model where it does just as well

requirements.text: Model calls go to OpenRouter with an API key the user supplies, stored only in the local database.
The model list is fetched live from OpenRouter, and the picker for the diary agent offers only vision models that support tool calling.
Every model request is recorded in a usage ledger under the feature that made it, including those made by the Android check-in worker.
The Costs page shows spend in total, by feature, by model and over time.
Photos leave the device only as the payload of a request to the model the user chose.
